Name: Portable Chest
Author: yyykkk3
Description:
Description
Adds a convenient portable chest to Stardew Valley. Simply press the K key anytime in-game to open a shared storage chest without returning to your farm.

Installation instructions
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Unzip the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

Main features
- Press K to open your portable chest anywhere in the world.
- Uses global inventory storage, so all your items are safely saved with your game file.
- Supports standard chest features like item organizing and color picking.

Requirements
- SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)
